---
name: link-audit
description: Audit Ventura APIs provider and documentation links for canonical targets duplicates and stale endpoints. Use when maintaining or releasing the curated API index. Do not use when testing whether an API's runtime endpoint currently returns correct application data.
---

# Link audit

- Check links in changed API entries.
- Prefer official provider documentation and developer portals.
- Detect duplicate APIs listed under aliases.
- Flag moved deprecated or obviously stale documentation links.
- Keep historical APIs only when explicitly labeled archival or deprecated.
- Recheck Markdown formatting after edits.
